name: @poker-club/mobile
//build-stamp: Settings prints which build the phone is running, and `scripts/build-stamp.mjs` is where that string comes from. It has to be an EXPO_PUBLIC_ variable rather than app.config.js's `extra`, because `expo export --platform web` embeds app.json and NOT the evaluated dynamic config — so `extra` reaches a phone and is null in the browser preview and in every UI check, which is the half nothing can see. Metro inlines EXPO_PUBLIC_ on every platform, which is the same mechanism the Supabase keys already use.
//qrcode: Pinned EXACTLY, not caret-ranged: src/lib/qr.ts imports qrcode/lib/core/qrcode.js, which is internal to the package and not covered by its semver promise. The renderers behind the main entry need canvas or fs and cannot run here.
//expo-updates: Nothing imports it. It is here because `eas update` refuses to publish without it, and publishing is how the app reaches an iPhone with no paid Apple Developer account behind it — see docs/live-test.md. In Expo Go the native side is Expo Go's own, so the package is inert at runtime. ~58.0.18 is SDK 58's version from bundledNativeModules.json, which is exactly what `expo install` would have chosen.
//sdk: Expo SDK 58, pinned to match the Expo Go build in the App Store (58.0.5, 22 October 2026). Every version below comes from SDK 58's own bundledNativeModules manifest — do not bump one on its own. SDK 57 unified the expo-* packages onto the SDK's own version number, which is why they all read ~57.x rather than a version apiece.

scripts.//publish:go: Put the app where a phone can open it in Expo Go with NO dev server and NO laptop — the update is fetched from Expo over any connection. EAS_PROJECT=go is the load-bearing part: it leaves runtimeVersion off, and an update carrying one is refused by Expo Go. Needs `npx eas-cli login` as the account that owns the project, and the phone's Expo Go signed into the same account. docs/live-test.md is the whole procedure.
scripts.publish:go: EAS_PROJECT=go env $(node ../../scripts/build-stamp.mjs) npx eas-cli@latest update --branch expo-go --message "$(git log -1 --pretty=%s)"
scripts.//export:web: A static build of the real app, for scripts/ui-check.mjs to drive in a headless browser. Same components, same tokens, at the frames' 402x874.
